name: Ligne Paper
tagline: cblain's « La ligne du temps »: paper to near-black pivot, terracotta on the moments that count, oversize-and-blurred arrivals.

motion.direction: cblain « La ligne du temps ». A paper world (`stage` / `mar`) for the solution and a near-black pivot (`card` mode) for the problem; ONE accent, terracotta `ter`, only for the moments that count. Subtitles 60–64 px IBM Plex Sans 600, ≤ 45 chars, word by word on the voice: each word arrives at 35 % then goes to ink in 0.2 s, one key word per sentence in a small accent box (radius 3, never black). An EVENT every 0.5–1 s (0.1–0.3 s in the hook): gestures 1–6 frames, the whole shot drifting 1–10 %/s; elements arrive too big (×1.1 whole shot, ×3–6 object) and blurred 6–12 px, settling in 1–9 frames; camera notches 0.08–0.15 s with blur; numbers roll or rush from camera, never faded; 2–3 "typographic moments" at 84 px per film, 3–4 giant emotional peaks at most. Bridge object at every seam; no grey filler bars, no abstract symbols.
